# Implementation Plan: ralph-overview ready-list/recommendations exclude merged/archived lifecycle

<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"overview-parallel-ready-excludes-merged-lifecycle"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-25. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`.*

## Overview

The ralph-overview overview surface reconciles two intentionally-separate axes: the bookkeeper-authoritative `OverviewTask.lifecycle` (`tracked` | `merged` | `archived`, in `.ralph-overview/data.json`) and the watcher-derived `RalphPipelineState.stage` (in `.ralph-overview/generated/ralph-state.{json,js}`). The MCP `overview.parallel_ready_tasks` tool was made lifecycle-first in **v2.10.0** and already hard-excludes `merged`/`archived` before its stage gate. But the **watcher recommendation path** was never given the same gate, and there are in fact **three** un-gated actionable surfaces:

1. `scoreRecommendations()` computes `topRecommendations` purely from the stage axis (`byTaskId`) and never consults `lifecycle`, so an already-shipped (`merged`) or `archived` task whose watcher stage is stale/non-terminal (e.g. still `implementing` or `plan-ready`) leaks back into the recommendations (→ `recommendations.json` + `snapshot.recommendations`). Observed 2026-06-09: ~6 merged tasks shown as "ready".
2. `computeUnblockCandidate()` (Node) gates only on `status === 'blocked'` + blockers all-merged, never on the candidate task's OWN lifecycle, so a `merged`/`archived` blocked task surfaces as an actionable "unblock candidate" in `snapshot.recommendations`, the per-task `snapshot.unblockCandidate` flag, and the `overview.unblock_candidates` MCP tool (which reads that per-task flag).
3. The **viewer recomputes NOTIFY chips client-side** via a *duplicated* `computeUnblockCandidate` in `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.ts` (used by `TaskCommand.tsx` command-row chips and `Kanban.tsx` kanban pills), with the same missing gate — so the dashboard a human looks at would still show a NOTIFY chip on a merged/archived blocked task even after the Node-side fix.

This plan adds an alias-aware lifecycle gate to all three surfaces, reusing the canonical `classifyShard()` helper on the Node side and the existing browser-safe `taskLifecycle()` helper on the viewer side, while keeping the lifecycle/stage axis split fully intact. It ships as a minor plugin version bump (`2.13.0 → 2.14.0`) with the standard three-manifest + three-marketplace-index + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md ceremony. Code lives in the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule (two-commit flow; the codexu lead bumps the submodule pointer at ship).

> **Phase 4 plan review (Claude + Codex + Copilot) findings are addressed inline below.** Key corrections folded in: (H) the release touches THREE per-engine `plugin.json` manifests, not one; (H) the unblock regression cases are driven by a SHARED fixture consumed by both the Node and viewer tests, so legacy-`phase` cases must be Node-only to avoid breaking `test:viewer`; (M) `blockerSummary()`'s literal blocker-merged check is out of scope; (M) the MCP `overview.unblock_candidates` surface is fixed transitively via the per-task snapshot flag. See the `<details>` block at the end for the full review log.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
Plugin root: `ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph-overview/`. Verified file:line facts (two Explore agents + Codex + Copilot research + a Phase-4 Claude review all cross-checked against the live code):

- **`scripts/lib/score-recommendations.mjs`** — `scoreRecommendations({ byTaskId, overviewData, prdsByTaskId, weights, topN, now })`:
  - `tasksById` built at **line 45** from `overviewData.tasks` (filter `task?.id`); used today ONLY for `?.priority` (**line 63**). `task.lifecycle` is never consulted. `tasksById` is NOT alias-aware (raw tasks).
  - `topRecommendations` from `Object.entries(byTaskId)` (**line 56**); `.filter` chain **lines 75–76**: `entry.stage !== 'shipped'` and `!candidateTaskIds.has(entry.taskId)` only.
  - `unblockCandidates` built **lines 47–53** from `findUnblockCandidates(overviewData)`; `candidateTaskIds` (line 54) deduped out of topRecommendations.
  - Returns `{ topRecommendations, unblockCandidates }` (**line 80**).
- **`scripts/lib/unblock-candidates.mjs`** — `computeUnblockCandidate(task, tasksById)` (**lines 1–20**) computes `blockers` (line 3) then gates only on `task?.status !== 'blocked'` (**line 5**), `blockedOn.length`, and blockers all `lifecycle === 'merged'` (via `blockerSummary`, **lines 32–40**, a literal `lifecycle === 'merged'` check on each blocker); **the candidate task's own lifecycle is never checked**. `findUnblockCandidates(overviewData)` (**lines 22–30**) maps every task through it.
- **`scripts/lib/data-store.mjs`** — `export const COLD_LIFECYCLES = new Set(['merged','archived'])` (**line 18**); `export function classifyShard(task)` → `'cold'` for merged/archived else `'hot'` (**lines 61–63**), alias-aware via `resolveTaskLifecycle`. Node-only (imports `node:fs`) — must NOT be imported into the viewer.
- **`scripts/lib/task-aliases.mjs`** — `resolveTaskLifecycle(task)` = `task?.lifecycle ?? mapLegacyPhase(task?.phase) ?? null` (**lines 20–22**); `mapLegacyPhase`: `shipped→merged`, `closed→archived`, `plan-ready→tracked`, else passthrough (**lines 43–54**).
- **`scripts/lib/emit-derived-artifacts.mjs`** — imports `scoreRecommendations` (**:7**), calls it (**:28–34**), writes `recommendations.json` from `{ ...recommendations }` (**:45–48**). Sole production caller of `scoreRecommendations` (invoked from the `sync-core.mjs:535` watcher derive path).
- **`scripts/lib/emit-snapshot.mjs`** — `buildSnapshot` flattens `[...topRecommendations, ...unblockCandidates]` via `normalizeRecommendations` (**:26, :34, :42–53**) into `snapshot.recommendations` (a flatten of `scoreRecommendations`' output, NOT a re-derivation). It ALSO sets a per-task `snapshotTask.unblockCandidate = true` flag independently via `computeUnblockCandidate` (**:21–23**).
- **MCP `overview.unblock_candidates`** — `tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/unblock-candidates.ts` (**lines 45–46**) reads `snapshot.tasks` filtered by `task.unblockCandidate === true` (the per-task flag from `emit-snapshot.mjs`). It does NOT call `findUnblockCandidates` — so gating the Node `computeUnblockCandidate` fixes this surface TRANSITIVELY via the snapshot flag.
- **Viewer (client-side NOTIFY chips):**
  - `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.ts` (**lines 3–9**) — DUPLICATE `computeUnblockCandidate(task, tasksById): boolean`: `task?.status !== 'blocked' || blockedOn.length === 0 → false`, else `blockedOn.every((id) => tasksById.get(id)?.lifecycle === 'merged')`. Does NOT gate the candidate's own lifecycle.
  - `tools/overview-viewer/src/components/TaskCommand.tsx:572` — `const showUnblockNotify = computeUnblockCandidate(task, effectiveTasksById)` drives the command-row NOTIFY chip.
  - `tools/overview-viewer/src/components/Kanban.tsx:40` — `injectKanbanUnblockPill` gates on `computeUnblockCandidate(task, tasksById)` for the kanban NOTIFY pill.
  - `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/taskAliases.ts:7` — `taskLifecycle(task)` = `task.lifecycle ?? task.phase` (browser-safe, imports only types; already imported by both components). **NOTE: returns raw `task.phase`** (does NOT map `shipped→merged`/`closed→archived`), so it resolves the modern `lifecycle` field; the hand-curated `.ralph-overview/data.json` uses `lifecycle`.
- **`tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/parallel-ready-tasks.ts`** — already gated: `EXCLUDED_LIFECYCLES` (**:25**) applied at **:141** before the stage gate. **Do not retouch.**
- **Tests (fixture architecture — load-bearing):**
  - `scripts/lib/score-recommendations.test.mjs` — vitest; inline `byTaskId`/`overviewData.tasks`/`prdsByTaskId` fixtures; `NOW` constant + weight presets; `top()`/`scoreByTask()` helpers ~lines 224–230; existing unblock tests lines 182–205 and dedup 207–221 use `lifecycle:'merged'` blockers + `status:'blocked'` candidates. Self-contained (no shared fixture).
  - `scripts/lib/unblock-candidates.test.mjs` — **fixture-driven** (**lines 9–10**): loads `scripts/lib/fixtures/unblock-candidates-truth-table.json`, iterates `fixture.cases.filter(!batch)` and asserts `result.unblockCandidate` AND `result.blockers` (**lines 13–22**); a batch case drives `findUnblockCandidates` (**lines 24–27**).
  - `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.test.ts` — **consumes the SAME shared fixture** (`import fixture from '../../../../scripts/lib/fixtures/unblock-candidates-truth-table.json'`, **line 3**), iterates the same non-batch cases and asserts ONLY `expected.unblockCandidate` (boolean) (**lines 8–16**). Co-located beside the util (NOT under `__tests__/`).
  - `scripts/lib/emit-snapshot.test.mjs` + `scripts/lib/emit-derived-artifacts.test.mjs` exist and are wired into `package.json` `scripts.test:lib`. Viewer tests run via `npm run test:viewer`.

### Technical Constraints
- Keep the lifecycle/stage axes separate — gate the ready/recommendation surface on lifecycle; do NOT collapse lifecycle into stage or change watcher stage derivation.
- Unknown lifecycle (a `byTaskId` entry with no matching `overviewData.tasks` row) must NOT be excluded — mirror the MCP tool's `lifecycle ?? ''` "unknown → not excluded" behavior. With `classifyShard`, an absent task → `resolveTaskLifecycle(undefined)` → `null` → not cold → kept; add an explicit `!task` guard for clarity (redundant-but-safe).
- Use the alias-aware `classifyShard` on the Node side (not a literal `lifecycle`-only Set) so legacy `phase: shipped`/`closed` are handled — required because unit tests feed raw (un-normalized) tasks even though production `loadOverviewData`/`normalizeOverviewTask` already maps `phase→lifecycle`.
- Do NOT import `scripts/lib/data-store.mjs` (or any `node:fs` module) into the viewer bundle. The viewer gate must use the existing browser-safe `taskLifecycle()` from `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/taskAliases.ts`.
- **Shared-fixture alias-awareness mismatch (load-bearing):** the Node `computeUnblockCandidate` (alias-aware via `classifyShard`) and the viewer `computeUnblockCandidate` (uses `taskLifecycle` = raw `lifecycle ?? phase`) both iterate `unblock-candidates-truth-table.json`. A candidate case with modern `lifecycle: merged`/`archived` is excluded by BOTH gates (safe to share). A candidate case with legacy `phase: shipped`/`closed` is excluded by the Node gate but NOT by the viewer gate — so it must NOT be added to the shared fixture (it would make `test:viewer` fail). Legacy-`phase` candidate cases are Node-only.
- Architecture invariant #1: no consumer-specific defaults in production code.
- `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule: two-commit flow (impl member commits in the submodule + pushes to all submodule remotes incl. `gim-home`; codexu lead bumps the submodule pointer and updates codexu AGENTS.md active-plugin-versions table). codexu root `CLAUDE.md` is gitignored — never edit it.

## Approach

### Architecture
Add one alias-aware "cold lifecycle" exclusion at each of the three surfaces, each at the smallest correct point:

1. **`topRecommendations` (stage-keyed)** — the observed bug. Only `scoreRecommendations` can gate this (keyed on `byTaskId`, not the overview task list). Add a filter dropping entries whose overview task classifies as `cold`. Fixes `recommendations.json` and `snapshot.recommendations` (the flatten) in one place.
2. **Unblock candidates (Node)** — gate inside `computeUnblockCandidate` (the shared predicate). A `merged`/`archived` task is by definition not a candidate for unblocking. Gating here is DRY and fixes the `unblockCandidates` array (→ `snapshot.recommendations`), the per-task `snapshot.unblockCandidate` flag, AND the `overview.unblock_candidates` MCP tool (which reads that per-task flag) at once.
3. **Viewer NOTIFY chips (browser)** — gate inside the viewer's duplicated `computeUnblockCandidate` using `taskLifecycle()`. Fixes the command-row chip (`TaskCommand.tsx`) and kanban pill (`Kanban.tsx`) without touching the components.

This resolves the research divergence: the architect favored gating ONLY `scoreRecommendations`; Codex+Copilot showed that leaves the per-task NOTIFY flag (Node) and the viewer's client-side recompute leaking. The complete fix is logically sound and aligned with the goal ("never surface merged/archived as actionable").

### Implementation Strategy
1. `scripts/lib/score-recommendations.mjs`: `import { classifyShard } from './data-store.mjs'`. In the `topRecommendations` filter chain (after the existing `stage !== 'shipped'` filter), add `.filter((entry) => { const t = tasksById.get(entry.taskId); return !t || classifyShard(t) !== 'cold' })`.
2. `scripts/lib/unblock-candidates.mjs`: `import { classifyShard } from './data-store.mjs'`. In `computeUnblockCandidate`, AFTER computing `blockers` but before the `status !== 'blocked'` check, early-return a non-candidate when the task itself is cold: `if (classifyShard(task) === 'cold') return { unblockCandidate: false, blockers, reason: 'task already merged/archived' }`. (Returning `blockers` keeps the return shape that `unblock-candidates.test.mjs` asserts.)
3. `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.ts`: `import { taskLifecycle } from './taskAliases'`. Add an early `if (task && (taskLifecycle(task) === 'merged' || taskLifecycle(task) === 'archived')) return false` before the existing `status`/`blockedOn` check.
4. Tests:
   - **Shared fixture** `scripts/lib/fixtures/unblock-candidates-truth-table.json`: add non-batch cases with the CANDIDATE task carrying modern `lifecycle: 'merged'` and `lifecycle: 'archived'` (with `status: 'blocked'` + a `lifecycle: 'merged'` blocker so the pre-fix code would have made it a candidate), `expected.unblockCandidate: false`, and the explicit `expected.blockers` array. These are exercised by BOTH `unblock-candidates.test.mjs` (Node) and `unblockCandidates.test.ts` (viewer), satisfying criteria 4 + 5 for modern lifecycle in one place. Optionally extend the `batch` case's expected `taskIds` if a new candidate id would otherwise sort in.
   - **Node-only inline** in `scripts/lib/unblock-candidates.test.mjs`: add `test(...)` block(s) (NOT via the shared fixture) constructing a candidate with legacy `phase: 'shipped'` and `phase: 'closed'`, asserting `computeUnblockCandidate(...).unblockCandidate === false` (alias-aware). Keep these OUT of the shared fixture (the viewer gate would not exclude them).
   - **`scripts/lib/score-recommendations.test.mjs`** (Node-only inline): merged, archived, legacy `phase: shipped`, legacy `phase: closed` candidate excluded from `topRecommendations`; `tracked`-ready kept; `byTaskId` entry absent from `overviewData.tasks` kept. (criteria 1–3)
   - **`scripts/lib/emit-snapshot.test.mjs`** (thin): a merged blocked task is NOT flagged per-task `unblockCandidate` and is absent from `snapshot.recommendations`. This is also the evidence for the MCP `overview.unblock_candidates` surface (which reads `snapshot.tasks[].unblockCandidate`). (criterion 7)
   - **`scripts/lib/emit-derived-artifacts.test.mjs`** (thin): a merged task with a stale non-terminal `byTaskId` stage is absent from the written `recommendations.json` `topRecommendations`. (criterion 7)
   - The viewer test (`src/utils/unblockCandidates.test.ts`) requires NO new file — it auto-iterates the shared fixture additions. (criterion 8)
5. Release ceremony — version bump across all three `plugin.json` manifests + three marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md note + policy validator.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Alias-aware lifecycle (`merged`/`archived`, incl. legacy `phase` on the Node side) exclusion of the watcher `topRecommendations`, the Node unblock-candidate predicate, and the viewer client-side NOTIFY recompute.
- Regression tests for the recommendation + unblock paths (via the shared fixture for modern lifecycle + Node-only inline for legacy phase), thin inheritance guards on the derived-artifacts + snapshot emitters; the viewer test inherits the shared-fixture additions.
- ralph-overview minor version bump across all three `plugin.json` manifests + three marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG + plugin AGENTS.md note; `validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs` pre-flight.

### Out of Scope
- `tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/parallel-ready-tasks.ts` (already lifecycle-gated, v2.10.0).
- **`blockerSummary()`'s literal `lifecycle === 'merged'` blocker-completion check** in `unblock-candidates.mjs` (lines 32–40). It is NOT alias-aware (a blocker with legacy `phase: 'shipped'` and no `lifecycle` is not treated as merged), but that is pre-existing v2.8.0 unblock-candidate semantics about BLOCKER completion, distinct from this fix's CANDIDATE-lifecycle exclusion. Changing it is a separate concern; if desired, file a follow-up.
- Collapsing the lifecycle/stage axes or altering watcher stage derivation.
- Any viewer redesign or component-logic change beyond the one-line predicate gate (the NOTIFY chip simply stops rendering for cold tasks); regenerating the consumer's `overview.html` artifact (consumer-side rebuild, not part of the plugin commit).
- Extending the viewer's `taskLifecycle()` to map legacy `phase` values (pre-existing behavior; data.json uses `lifecycle`).
- New dependencies; consumer (codexu) data changes; the codexu submodule-pointer bump (lead-owned).

## Risk Areas
- **Shared-fixture / viewer-non-alias hazard (HIGH — Phase-4 finding).** `scripts/lib/fixtures/unblock-candidates-truth-table.json` is consumed by THREE assertions across two workspaces: Node `unblock-candidates.test.mjs` (alias-aware `classifyShard`) and viewer `unblockCandidates.test.ts` (non-alias `taskLifecycle`). Adding a legacy `phase: shipped`/`closed` CANDIDATE case to the shared fixture would make the viewer test FAIL (`test:viewer`) because the viewer gate would not exclude it. Modern `lifecycle: merged`/`archived` candidate cases ARE safe to share. Keep legacy-phase candidate cases Node-only and inline.
- **Existing test fixtures unaffected (verified).** Every candidate task in the current `unblock-candidates-truth-table.json` and in `emit-snapshot.test.mjs` has merged blockers but a non-cold CANDIDATE lifecycle, and the existing tests assert only `unblockCandidate` + `blockers` (not `reason`). The new early-return's distinct `reason` string is untested, so the existing cases stay green. Still run the full suites to confirm.
- **Alias-awareness regression (Node).** A literal `lifecycle`-only Set would pass production but fail the mandated legacy-`phase` test — use `classifyShard`. Ensure the import path is `./data-store.mjs` (sibling in `scripts/lib/`).
- **Browser import boundary.** Do NOT import `data-store.mjs`/`classifyShard` into the viewer (`node:fs`). Use `taskLifecycle()` from `./taskAliases`.
- **Unknown-lifecycle false exclusion.** A `byTaskId` entry absent from `overviewData.tasks` must remain eligible — keep the `!task` guard.
- **Release version-file completeness (HIGH — Phase-4 finding).** SIX version-bearing files must move together: three `plugin.json` manifests (`.claude-plugin/`, `.codex-plugin/`, `.github/plugin/`) + three marketplace indexes (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`). Missing the `.codex-plugin/` or `.github/plugin/` manifest leaves Codex/Copilot plugin metadata stale at 2.13.0. `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` policy enums must stay in the accepted set (run the validator).

## Acceptance Criteria
1. In `scripts/lib/score-recommendations.mjs`, a task whose overview `lifecycle` is `merged` or `archived` (alias-aware, incl. legacy `phase: shipped`/`closed`) is excluded from `topRecommendations` regardless of its `byTaskId` Ralph stage (e.g. `implementing`, `plan-ready`).
2. A `lifecycle: tracked` task with a ready (non-`shipped`) stage STILL appears in `topRecommendations` (no regression).
3. A `byTaskId` entry with no matching `overviewData.tasks` row (unknown lifecycle) STILL appears in `topRecommendations`.
4. In `scripts/lib/unblock-candidates.mjs`, `computeUnblockCandidate` returns `unblockCandidate: false` (with its `blockers` array still populated) for a task whose own lifecycle is `merged`/`archived` (alias-aware), even when `status: 'blocked'` and all blockers are merged; consequently such a task does not appear in `findUnblockCandidates`, in `scoreRecommendations().unblockCandidates`, in `snapshot.recommendations`, as a per-task `snapshot.unblockCandidate` flag, or — transitively, via that flag — in the `overview.unblock_candidates` MCP tool (`tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/unblock-candidates.ts` reads `snapshot.tasks[].unblockCandidate`).
5. In `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.ts`, the duplicated `computeUnblockCandidate` returns `false` for a task whose `taskLifecycle(task)` is `merged`/`archived`, so neither the command-row NOTIFY chip (`TaskCommand.tsx`) nor the kanban NOTIFY pill (`Kanban.tsx`) renders for such a task; a `tracked` blocked task with all-merged blockers still returns `true`.
6. Regression cases:
   - **Shared fixture** (`unblock-candidates-truth-table.json`): modern `lifecycle: merged` and `lifecycle: archived` CANDIDATE cases (asserting `unblockCandidate: false` + `blockers`), exercised by both the Node and viewer tests (covers criteria 4 + 5 for modern lifecycle).
   - **Node-only inline** (`unblock-candidates.test.mjs` + `score-recommendations.test.mjs`): legacy `phase: shipped`/`closed` candidate exclusion (alias-aware), `tracked`-ready kept, unknown-lifecycle kept (covers criteria 1–4 for legacy/edge cases). These are NOT added to the shared fixture.
7. Thin Node inheritance assertions added: `emit-derived-artifacts.test.mjs` (merged task absent from written `recommendations.json` `topRecommendations`) and `emit-snapshot.test.mjs` (merged blocked task absent from `snapshot.recommendations` and not flagged per-task `unblockCandidate` — also the evidence for the MCP `overview.unblock_candidates` surface).
8. The existing viewer test `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.test.ts` (which auto-iterates the shared fixture) passes for the new merged/archived candidate cases with no new file added.
9. `npm run test:lib`, `npm run test:viewer`, and `npm run typecheck` all pass green, with output saved to `test-output-lib.log`, `test-output-viewer.log`, and `test-output-typecheck.log` respectively (per repo convention), and no pre-existing tests broken.
10. All three `plugin.json` manifests (`plugins/ralph-overview/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.github/plugin/plugin.json`) AND all three marketplace indexes (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`) show the ralph-overview version/entry at `2.14.0`.
11. `plugins/ralph-overview/CHANGELOG.md` has a `[2.14.0]` entry describing the recommendations + unblock + viewer-NOTIFY lifecycle gate (and noting parallel_ready_tasks was already gated in v2.10.0); `plugins/ralph-overview/AGENTS.md` has a matching behavioral note.
12. `node tools/validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs` (from toolkit root) exits 0.
13. The lifecycle/stage axis split is preserved — no production code collapses lifecycle into stage; the only behavioral change is the exclusion gate.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition
- **US-001** — Node-side lifecycle gate in `scoreRecommendations` (`topRecommendations`) + `computeUnblockCandidate`, with regression tests (shared fixture modern cases + Node-only inline legacy/edge cases) and thin emitter inheritance guards (criteria 1–4, 6–7, 13).
- **US-002** — Viewer NOTIFY-chip lifecycle gate in `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/unblockCandidates.ts`; the existing co-located viewer test inherits the shared-fixture additions from US-001 (criteria 5, 8).
- **US-003** — ralph-overview release ceremony: version bump across three `plugin.json` manifests + three marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md note + policy validator (criteria 9–12). Depends on US-001 and US-002.

## Suggested Decomposition

All three stories touch the same plugin. US-001 (Node lib + tests + shared fixture) and US-002 (viewer util) are different workspaces but the viewer test depends on US-001's shared-fixture additions, and US-003 (release ceremony) edits the plugin version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS.md after both. Splitting across parallel members would race the plugin metadata files and the single version bump. Run as ONE serial cluster handled by ONE impl member.

### Cluster: recommendations-lifecycle-gate
- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None

## Open Questions
- **Unblock-gate scope (resolved):** This plan gates `computeUnblockCandidate` (Node, shared predicate) AND the viewer's duplicated predicate, which changes the per-task `snapshot.unblockCandidate` flag, the `overview.unblock_candidates` MCP tool, and the viewer NOTIFY chips — intentionally, since all are actionable surfaces and a merged/archived task is logically never an unblock candidate. The narrower alternative (gate only `topRecommendations` in `scoreRecommendations`) would fix the observed recommendations leak but leave the unblock-candidate surfaces (incl. the dashboard NOTIFY chips a human sees) leaking.
- **`blockerSummary` alias-awareness (resolved → out of scope):** the literal `lifecycle === 'merged'` BLOCKER-completion check is pre-existing v2.8.0 semantics, distinct from candidate-lifecycle exclusion. Left out of scope; a follow-up can reuse `resolveTaskLifecycle` for blocker summaries if legacy-`phase` blockers ever appear in real data.
- Bump level is **minor** (`2.14.0`) by analogy to how the parallel_ready_tasks lifecycle gate shipped (v2.10.0, minor). A patch bump is defensible; minor chosen for the new observable exclusion behavior.
